description: Defines the RadixButton class, a custom control inheriting from RadioButton, with a method to retrieve and process its display value.

classes.name: RadixButton
classes.description: A sealed class extending RadioButton, providing a method to get the raw display value after removing group separators.

methods.name: GetRawDisplayValue
methods.description: Returns the content of the button as a string with group separators removed, using LocalizationSettings.
